hints.title: Hours and Minutes Independence
hints.text: The possible hour choices (00 to 23) and minute choices (00 to 59) are completely independent.

hints.title: Hour Pattern Matching
hints.text: Count how many integers H in [0, 23] formatted as two digits match the hour mask.

hints.title: Minute Pattern Matching
hints.text: Count how many integers M in [0, 59] formatted as two digits match the minute mask. Multiply hour choices by minute choices.

hints.title: Valid Time Pattern Counting Implementation

complexity.notes: Fixed 1440 iterations checking 5 character string matches.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Complex branching with question mark positions is error-prone.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) memory checks all clock configurations directly.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes small search space of 1440 minutes and evaluates match in constant time.
